categories.name: Tokenized Treasuries
categories.content: Tokenized Treasuries feature blockchain-native representations of marketable sovereign debt including T-bills, T-notes, and T-bonds that offer 24/7 on-chain access to yields through regulated, asset-backed tokens.

categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Uniswap v4 Hooks
categories.content: Tokens of protocols whose core product is built on Uniswap v4 hooks. Hooks turn the AMM from fixed infrastructure into a programmable platform, enabling designs that were impossible in earlier versions: dynamic fees that widen during volatility, MEV-mitigation through batched uniform-clearing-price execution, rehypothecation of idle liquidity into lending markets, vault-managed concentrated liquidity issued as fungible ERC-6909 positions, limit orders implemented as single-tick positions, and lending markets that share collateral with swap liquidity. Projects in this category use hooks as the foundation of their product rather than merely trading on Uniswap.

categories.name: Arcade Games

categories.name: Metagovernance
